entry.title: Dragon Ball Z Budokai 3 v0.2.4
entry.content:
**⚠️ Existing seeds must be regenerated.** Location names and item classifications changed, so a run generated on v0.2.3 or earlier will not work with this build. Finish it on the old version or reroll.
### Fixed
- **The Skill Shop sometimes opened as the normal shop instead of the AP shop** — capsule purchases didn't send checks, and the client froze for several seconds at a time. The shop now loads AP stock reliably and without the stall. - **Crash when entering your first Dragon Arena fight** after picking a stage. - **Winning a fight sometimes sent a DeathLink death.** If the KO registered just before the results screen appeared, your win was reported as a death. - **Quitting a Dragon Arena fight sent its death at the wrong moment** — it stayed queued and fired later, usually when you next walked into the arena. It now fires when you quit. - **Seeds with ShopSanity off:** the Skill Shop was emptied on every entry, so you couldn't buy anything with your Zeni. - **Kid Gohan's Frieza fight was mislabeled** as First Form — it's Third Form.
### Changed
- **Fight names are consistent.** Frieza uses ordinals (`Frieza 1st/2nd/3rd/Final Form`); Cell uses his real form names (`Imperfect Cell`, `Semi-Perfect Cell`, `Perfect Cell`) instead of a mix of numbers and parentheticals. - **Skill capsules are now `useful` instead of filler** — all 11 Breakthroughs plus every DU character ability (transformations, signature attacks, Unlock Potential, fusions). They're weighted better in placement and surface in trackers and hints. They still aren't required by logic.
### New
- **`/deathlink`** toggles DeathLink on or off mid-run from the client, and it sticks across reconnects.

entry.title: Custom Robo v1.0
entry.content:
**"A New Journey is about to commence! Now let me think about the order of events again..."**
### Custom Robo - V1.0 Release
The capabilities of the Memory Erasure Device are quite potent! So much so that our hero seems to have forgotten how everything played out... but not to worry! Those memories must be SOMEWHERE around the Multiworld...
Ah, and don't forget Dad's Watch! We'll need that too before we can go face the Outside World.
Features: ### **Progression is now gated behind the day's memories! You'll be needing those to relive each chapter of the adventure, because if you can't remember you'll simply have to repeat the current day until it comes to you.**
The following items are now part of the pool: - Chapter 3 Memories: gives access to License Test - Chapter 4 Memories: gives access to Family Matters - Chapter 5 Memories: gives access to the Bogey Tournament (and ultimately Shiner) - Chapter 6 Memories: gives access to the Gym Tournament - Chapter 7 Memories: gives access to Lab Guard Duty - Chapter 8 Memories: gives access to your first encounter with Rahu at Bogey's - Chapter 9 Memories: gives access to the Police 2v2 Tournament - Chapter 10 Memories: gives access to the secret S-Rank trials - Chapter 11 Memories: gives access to Rahu's return at Daimon - Dad's Watch: gives access to the Outside World (Go Mode)
(Do note that you'll need to collect all of your Memories to ultimately get through the New Journey to defeat Rahu III!)
### **Tired of talking to people? Great news! Several flag edits have been added to the client to suppress the need to TalkToEveryone (and Lucy in several places... sorry Lucy)**
The following chapters now operate as follows: - Chapter 1: You can talk to Harry to immediately leave the Lab after fighting the bandits - Chapter 5: You can talk to the Waiter to immediately start the Bogey Tourney - Chapter 6: Sophie is NOT waiting for you to talk with everyone, she now starts the Gym Tournament immediately - Chapter 7: You can talk to Harry to immediately progress to the next scene (no more running around the Lab!) - Chapter 9: You can just go talk with the Chief to start the Police 2v2 Tournament
### **Chapters can now be shuffled/randomized as a YAML option! When connecting, the Client will display your chapter order so you know which memories you'll need to progress.**
### **By popular demand, a new starting inventory option has been added: full Oil Can Parts**

entry.title: Taskipelago v1.2.0rc0
entry.content:
*The big region overhaul (and also clicker game mode)*
## What's new (v1.2.0) * New types of item grouping definitions. Now progressive, aesthetic, or random-choice * aesthetic groups merely group things aesthetically with no effect on progression or not. * random-choice groups randomly choose N or N% as you define items from within the group to be included in the world. No tasks may depend on individual items in these groups since they aren't guaranteed to exist, but depending on the randomized group as a whole or by percentage/count is supported. * progressive groups function the same as always * Regions can now also be randomized to include N or N% of tasks within that region. May optionally also shuffle the order in which such tasks appear. * Subregions can now be defined within regions that aren't randomized (subregions may be randomized). * Regions may now depend on items and tasks via the syntax item(expr) and task(expr) where expr is any valid task or item dependency expression * Tasclickpelago toggle on the yaml generator that enables a bunch of features for building out an idle game because the concept was funny and I thought of a way to do it well. * Style tab added to the YAML generator so you can recolor the entire application at will while connected to the slot in question. Pretty colors are pretty.
Note: should be fully backwards compatible with worlds generated from 1.0 onwards. Also Universal Tracker is still incompatible.

entry.title: CrossCode v0.9.8
entry.content:
# Changes since 0.9.8 Prerelease 1
## Changes to Mod
* Map markers that had significant overlap with other map markers have had their position manually adjusted to improve legibility (@CodeTriangle, #102). * In particular, this targets the overlapping chests in **Bergen Trail**, **Temple Mine**, **Faj'ro Temple**, and **So'najiz Temple**. * If any incidences remain of overlapping markers, please make me aware. * Map markers are now shown for chests added by the mod, such as the ones in the lobbies of **Faj'ro Temple** and **Grand Krys'kajo** (@CodeTriangle, #102).
## Fixes to Mod
* Fixed an issue where shop hints would not send unless both **Shop Dialog Hints** and **Quest Dialog Hints** were enabled (@CodeTriangle, #100). * Fixed an issue where botanics would not send immediately if the plant hit was an alternate form of the plant in question (@CodeTriangle, #100). * Map markers for chests that in the vanilla game contain chests keys no longer always display as unlocked.
## Fixes to Logic
* **Trial of Persistance Lower Left** no longer requires four So'najiz Keys to access (@CodeTriangle, #101).
# Changes since 0.9.7
## Changes to Mod
* Added more functionality to the Archipelago menus (@CodeTriangle, #98). * Text boxes now accept CTRL-V to paste and CTRL-U to clear. * Text client now automatically jumps to the bottom. * Text client can be scrolled one page at a time using L2/R2, and scrolled faster by holding R1 and using the right stick.
### Internal Changes
* Reformatted a large amount of input data (@Valkhiya, #93)
## Changes to APWorld
* Fixed one more instance of non-determinism, this time in the `pre_fill` function (@Gudf, CodeTriangle/Archipelago#27). * This should ensure that generations with the same seed produce the same output. * Replaced logic conditions with pre-optimized lambdas (@CodeTriangle, CodeTriangle/Archipelago#24). * This should speed up generation on large scales.
### Internal Changes
* Remove `LogicDict`, a legacy class used in logic, and replace it with a reference to the world itself (@CodeTriangle, CodeTriangle/Archipelago#28).

entry.title: plateup v0.2.7.1
entry.content:
## What's New?
* Fixed achievement checks not being included in the location pool — `achievement_check_mode` now actually adds achievement checks to your run, gated by day count and (for `earned_only`) by whether `appliance_unlocks` is enabled * Fixed dish-specific Day Leases wrongly chaining dishes together — each dish's day progression is now fully independent, instead of requiring an earlier-selected dish to be fully leased before a later dish could even start Day 1 * Fixed franchise runs under dish-specific Day Lease mode needing an ever-growing number of leases as `franchise_count` increased — leasing now correctly resets each franchise run instead of accumulating across all of them (thanks to Mike Lydeamore)
## Balance Changes
* `Complete Day N` and franchise-goal completions could previously become reachable with very few or zero items when using dish-specific Day Leases — some `complete_x_days` and `reach_day_x_with_dishes` goals could resolve almost immediately. This is fixed: a Day Lease pool sized to your goal's day count now always paces the day chain, independent of Day Lease mode * Franchise goal + dish-specific leasing now requires an available, sufficiently-leased dish for each individual run rather than pulling from one global cumulative lease pool, so high `franchise_count` values no longer demand disproportionately more leases

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.17.3
entry.content: ## Changes ### Added - **Server mods have three answers instead of a tick: off, only when a mission needs it, or always.** Installing a mod used to be the same thing as loading it, because the game server loads an extension whenever its file is on the disk. They are separate now. The default loads a mod only while your mission pool holds a mission that names it, so a run that never asks for SigMod never has it in the server. Turning a mod off leaves the download in place, so turning it back on costs nothing. - **SigMod is offered on Windows again**, through this project's own port, since upstream publishes no Windows build. It is off by default and the row reads **SigMod (beta)**: the port crashed one player's server, and the new loading setting is what makes it safe to offer. Leave it on **only when a mission needs it** unless you are testing it. Linux, Docker and WSL download upstream's build and are the safe way to play those missions today. - **Each reward family can be turned off.** Mission Ticket, Class Unlock and Weapon Slot Importance take **Disabled - All Unlocked**: everything starts unlocked and leaves the item pool, per-class slots included. Weapon Buff Importance takes **Disabled - No Buffs**, and the spare checks become cash. The defaults are unchanged. By kelly-cs. - **Remedic is labelled Medic only** in the mission table, the mission pool and the start-mission choices, since its population file bans every other class. By kelly-cs. - **Community archives are checked against a pinned hash.** The Potato and Moonlight snapshots now download from this project's GitHub release first, with the Potato servers as fallback, and a file whose hash differs is held back until you press **Ignore hash mismatch** on the Missions page. By kelly-cs. ### Fixed - **A server mod can be turned off.** Whether you run the launcher or the Docker stack, taking a mod out of the settings left it loading from the game files it had already been installed into, with nothing on screen admitting it. Both now take the marker away. - **Modifiers work on a Windows server.** Thirteen of the plugin's game hooks had no Windows signature, so a modifier could be drawn and announced while half of it did nothing. Faulty Calibration and Mental's cloak now work there, and a refused mission file is reported. Bot Surge's support fillers and Make it Count's dispenser limit still do nothing on Windows. - **A robot stuck protected in its spawn no longer holds the wave open.** After two minutes the plugin removes it. Condemned Trespasser wave 2 could not end without this. By kelly-cs. - **Bot Surge no longer loses scripted waves at once.** It shortened every spawn delay, including the timers some missions use to open the hatch, so Homestead Happenings wave 5 was lost after seven seconds. Only robot spawns are sped up now. By kelly-cs. - **Caliginous Caper wave 666 has its tanks and its Halloween look.** The stock file sends its tanks down a path the map does not have. The server now repairs it from your game files at start. By kelly-cs. - **SigMod no longer kicks RED defender bots.** Its robot limit counted them, so a crowded wave kicked one and the bots added it back, over and over. By kelly-cs. - **Ten community missions are marked as needing SigMod**, among them Bionic Breach, Nuclear Threat and Twilight Of Terror. They were offered without it and could not run. By kelly-cs. - **SigMod's extra loadout menu shows its item names and title** instead of `%t: %s %s %t`. On the Windows and Linux launchers, SigMod shows as not ready once after this update: press **Download / set up selected server mods** to apply the fix. By kelly-cs. - **Docker: editing SigMod's config no longer hides its missions**, and the settings page no longer points at a setup button that does nothing in Docker. By kelly-cs. - **Docker: Test mode uses the whole mission pool you asked for**, not eight, and the server picks up a new test run without a restart. By kelly-cs. - **The item server line no longer shows terminal color codes.** By kelly-cs. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * Fix mission table checkbox assertion for SigMod choice by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/136 * Fix Caliginous Caper wave 666 tanks and Halloween mode by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/120 * Stop RED defenders counting toward the invader limit by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/121 * Fix SigMod mission availability after editing server config by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/123 * fix(gamedata): mark missions using shared SigMod extensions by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/125 * Fix Docker test mission selection and stale plugin list by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/126 * Fix Bot Surge triggering scripted wave timers early by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/127 * Label Remedic as Medic only in mission lists by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/128 * fix(plugin): clear invaders stuck protected in spawn for >2 mins by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/129 * Pin community archive hashes and require mismatch approval by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/132 * Mirror pinned community archives on GitHub with Potato fallback by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/133 * Fix SigMod extra loadout item labels and title by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/134 * Fix terminal color codes in item server status by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/139 * Add explicit disabled modes for reward families by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/138 * Add an optional all-wave MvM smoke probe for docker by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/124 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.17.2...v1.17.3 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/Njk2NzFlZTc2YzM3YzhiMzdjYTQ3NjI5YTY2YjAzZTM6MTc5MDEwNjYyMw==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZmJjMjk0MDY3ZTM2NjQyY2NlZDE2N2Y1MDY4MjU4YjE6MTc5MDEwNjYyNQ==/detection)

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.1
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **If you are playing a seed with Shop Checks right now, reload the page and carry on.** You do not need a new seed, a new yaml, or the new APworld. The website has already updated. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Shop Checks never worked
Shop Checks has been broken since it was added in 1.7.0, for everyone, on every seed. Buying an item never sent its check.
The APworld built all 462 shop locations correctly, which is why they showed up in the tracker and could be released by hand. But it never told the website the option was on, and the website treats an option it was not told about as off. So the shop behaved exactly like vanilla and quietly sent nothing.
Thanks to the player who reported this.
### Your run is not lost
A seed generated before this release still does not say whether Shop Checks is on, so the website now works it out from the seed itself: only Shop Checks creates locations in the shop range. If they are there, the feature is on.
So an in-progress run recovers on its own. Reload the page and buying starts sending checks. **No regeneration.**
If you already released your shop checks by hand, the website now takes the server's word for which ones are done, so those items go back to being ordinary purchases instead of asking to be checked again. You will not pay for something that is already gone.
### Also
- New APworld tests assert that every option the website acts on actually reaches it. That is the check that was missing, and it is what let this ship in the first place.

entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.2
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Nothing to do.** No gameplay change, no option change, no seed change. If you are on 1.8.1 you are already up to date; the website has updated itself. - The APworld is identical to 1.8.1 apart from its version number, so there is no need to re-download it or regenerate anything. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Changes
### Client
- Removed ten leftover values the website set on connect and then never read. They were the boss class and stage requirements, which the website stopped using in 1.8.0 when it started evaluating the logic the seed ships. Leaving them in made it look like those gates were still wired up by hand, which is exactly the confusion that caused the 1.6.0 logic bugs. - The save is no longer fetched with an argument that was being read as a "watch this key" flag, so the server stops echoing a notification back on every single save.
Both are housekeeping following the 1.8.1 audit. Nothing you can see changed.
